selected_alternative: Separate PurePosixPath representation for argv and concrete Path for IO

alternatives.approach: PurePosixPath (or posixpath) explicitly models Linux destination independently of os.name. Concrete Path retained separately for IO.
Use (LINUX/script).as_posix() on host-concrete Path. Smaller patch for fixed literal; still interprets the input via host path semantics, so less explicit boundary.

interface.transport: List of argv tokens, no shell string/split/embedded quoting/URL encoding
posix_token_constraints: Spaces preserved in one list element
Same spelling on Windows and Linux
Same constructor for launch and identity/cleanup expected argv
interface.windows_io: WIN and BASE remain host-concrete Path; wsl.exe remains Windows path
interface.linux_io: LINUX remains concrete Path derived from POSIX text, used for IO only on Linux
interface.root_flag: Absent in source; no --root added. Contract covers representation if a later explicit interface supplies it.
interface.not_generic_converter: No inference from Windows drives or UNC, no shell quoting service, no arbitrary user path normalization

scope_preservation: Only import/representation binding/argv script token change in candidate
Consumed package must never receive this patch or be rerun
